name: Big Cubes in Bothell 2022

venue.name: Bothell United Methodist Church
venue.details: Fellowship Hall—first door to the right upon entry

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BigCubesinBothell2022#21839-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BigCubesinBothell2022#21837-health-and-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
